findings.problemShort: elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
findings.solutionShort: ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets wcag 2 aa minimum contrast ratio thresholds
findings.solutionLong:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 2.21 (foreground color: #a5a69e, background color: #f5f3eb, font size: 10.5pt (14px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

issue.title: Accessibility issue: Select element must have an accessible name on /

findings.problemShort: select element must have an accessible name
findings.solutionShort: ensure select element has an accessible name
findings.solutionLong:
Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have an implicit (wrapped) <label>
  Element does not have an explicit <label>
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"

findings.problemShort: <html> element must have a lang attribute
findings.solutionShort: ensure every html document has a lang attribute
findings.solutionLong:
Fix any of the following:
  The <html> element does not have a lang attribute

issue.title: Accessibility issue: <html> element must have a lang attribute on /

findings.solutionShort: ensure elements have alternative text or a role of none or presentation
findings.solutionLong:
Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have an alt attribute
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"
